questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I am interested in pharmacoepidemiology and I chose this course to broaden my knowledge. It was a great learning experience to attend lectures from 3 different professors and meet various students and early career scientists who share similar interest.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was a little challenging since I joined the course late, and I wasn't receiving some online correspondence. However, I managed to find all the information in time just by asking professors and colleagues.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: We have had dinner organized and were provided with snacks during the course. We didn't receive any special assistance, but that didn't seem to be necessary

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I chose and Airbnb, it was quite easy to find.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Depending on the city, it might get expensive, so book in advance.

questions.answer: I sent an application through an online form.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: No help was necessary. There was an email address given to the organizer of the course in case of questions.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I managed to register for the course I wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: To register as soon as possible
